contexts.text: They render him all the offices which he can desire.
The Angels desire nothing more than to render him offices.
The pleasures of offices in the commonwealth. AC 995:2.
When a man feels in himself that he... wants to perform offices to the neighbour...
That those who place worship solely in externals are able to perform vile offices. Signified.
The Angels are so named from their office.
The offices of the natural man. Signified, Explained.
One in self-love... and yet from the heart performs offices for the neighbour...
Spiritual truth and good will that man should... have pleasure in offices [performed] towards his country, and towards societies in general and in particular.
He is continually in the remembrance of the Lord, even when... he is discharging his public, or private, or domestic offices...
Having nothing of delight in their offices, but solely in being honoured.
Concerning offices and uses, Signified, Explained.
Works = goods; thus uses and offices; for these are goods.
Those who are such can discharge the more eminent offices like those who enjoy genuine conscience...
Uses consist in everyone's... performing offices prudently according to the quality of each person.
Charity... is to do right in every work, and our duty in every office. Example(s).
Thus functions and offices for them. Signified, Explained.
The Lord acts mediately through Heaven... in order that the Angels may have functions and offices, and thence life, and happiness according to their offices and uses.
This is as it is with the prefects, officers, and ministers in one royal palace...
The domestic servants obey and perform their offices.
They avert themselves from the offices of charity, through which there is conjunction with Heaven.
For every Society performs a peculiar office.
He who thinks about honour for himself... cannot discharge any office in Heaven.
In Heaven there are so many offices, and so many administrations, and also so many works, that they cannot be numbered...
The spiritual Angels... perform for the new Spirit all the offices which he can ever desire...
Those who... in their offices and functions have regarded self-honour... are more stupid than all others.
The joy of the Angels consists in activities and manifested offices...
Man is first received by Angels who perform for him all offices...
To do uses, in Heaven, is to act sincerely, rightly, justly, and faithfully in the work which belongs to one's office. This they call charity.
They are set over Societies... according to the amplitude of the offices which they had discharged...
Everyone in Heaven, who is in a function, discharges his office in his Society, as in the world; but under the auspices of the Lord.
Until noon all are in their offices and their works.
(Until noon) all are strictly performing the duties of their offices.
(The application of the woman) is to various offices which are called domestic, which adjoin themselves to the offices of the men, which are called forensic.

That there are offices proper to the man, and offices proper to the wife; and that the wife cannot enter into the offices proper to the man, nor the man into the offices proper to the wife, and discharge them rightly. General article.

It is believed by many that women can discharge the offices of men, provided they are initiated into them when very young... They can [be initiated] into the exercise of them, but not into the judgment upon which the rectitude of the offices interiorly depends...
That these offices, according to mutual aid, also conjoin the two into a one; and at the same time make one house. Explained.
They can be conjoined... by mutual offices...
(Conjugial simulations) for the sake of some offices...
(Conjugial simulations) where the parents, relations, and friends of the wife are in offices of dignity...
Every wife loves her husband... from his intelligence in his office and manners.
Every function, which is manifold in one kingdom, (would fall to pieces unless it depended) upon one official.
There is a general envelope around every member (of the body)... so that they act as a one in every office and use.
Can he not his office? do goods in his house, and in his office?
For there are in the world higher and lower offices, in subordination according to their more or less universal government over Societies...
That charity itself is to act justly and faithfully in the office, business, and work in which anyone is... General article. TCR 459:13.
A distinction is to be made between the offices of charity and its benefactions. Explained.
Taxes... are collected for... the administration by officials and prefects, to whom salaries and stipends are to be paid from the public treasury.
To live morally, that is... to perform the offices of honourableness...
The simple and the learned are regenerated differently; as are... those who are in different offices.
With a simulation of offices.
The officials are the members and viscera of the king who is the head.
In a word, there are innumerable offices (in Heaven).
The like takes place with those who are in offices and in dignity, and think only about themselves...
d. Because in the world they had not applied themselves to any offices, except for the sake of honour and gain...
When the officials (of the Czar) say that it is his command.

He who discharges an office, and who performs his office for the sake of merit (has merit in his good works)... But he who does not place merit therein does it for the sake of duty, because it is of his office. In this lies hidden the fear of God, and also a general love... but in the former the love of self and the world.
At the right (in the London there) dwells the moderator; and round about there, his officials.
By uses are meant the uses of the function of each person, which belong to his office, study, and work.
Magistrates, prefects, and officials, who discharge their functions and duties with all diligence and industry (have among them) many who do this from natural affection only...
4. That use is to discharge one's office rightly, faithfully, sincerely, and justly... Explained.
A priest in preaching, a prefect and official in administration...
That ministries, functions, offices, and various works are the goods of use General article. civil.
By functions are meant various offices which are civil.
By offices are meant various studies, businesses, and domestic servantships.
Charity with the officials under magistrates. Explained, Defined.
